name: Ucal
title: Recipient of Agur's words of wisdom
summary: Ucal is a person mentioned in Proverbs 30:1, along with Ithiel, as the recipient of the wise sayings of Agur son of Jakeh. Very little is known about Ucal beyond this single reference, and some biblical scholars suggest that the name may be part of a Hebrew sentence rather than a proper noun. Regardless of interpretation, Ucal is linked to the wisdom tradition in the Old Testament.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as recipient of Agur's words
keyEvents.description: Ucal is mentioned together with Ithiel as one of those to whom Agur son of Jakeh directed his wise sayings.

keyEvents.title: Agur's humble confession
keyEvents.description: In the context where Ucal is mentioned, Agur confesses his own limited understanding and points to God's greatness and wisdom.

keyEvents.title: Agur's prayer for truth and moderation
keyEvents.description: The wise sayings addressed to Ucal and Ithiel include a famous prayer to be kept from falsehood and to have neither poverty nor riches.

keyEvents.title: Numerical proverbs of wisdom
keyEvents.description: The subsequent wise sayings in Agur's collection, which Ucal received, contain characteristic numerical proverbs about the mysteries of life.
